import pandas as pd, numpy as np, scipy.stats as st, re, time
pge='inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv'; pex='inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv'
t=time.time(); ge=pd.read_csv(pge,index_col=0); ex=pd.read_csv(pex,index_col=0)
print('loaded',ge.shape,ex.shape,'sec',round(time.time()-t,2),flush=True)
rows=ge.index.intersection(ex.index,sort=False)
cols=ge.columns.intersection(ex.columns,sort=False)
g=ge.loc[rows,cols].to_numpy(); x=ex.loc[rows,cols].to_numpy(); labels=np.asarray(cols)
res=np.full(len(cols),np.nan)
complete=~np.isnan(g).any(axis=0)
print('aligned',len(rows),len(cols),'complete',complete.sum(),'incomplete',(~complete).sum(),flush=True)
# Chunked vectorized Spearman for complete columns.
ci=np.flatnonzero(complete)
for start in range(0,len(ci),1000):
 ix=ci[start:start+1000]
 rx=st.rankdata(x[:,ix],axis=0,method='average')
 rg=st.rankdata(g[:,ix],axis=0,method='average')
 rx-=rx.mean(axis=0); rg-=rg.mean(axis=0)
 res[ix]=(rx*rg).sum(axis=0)/np.sqrt((rx*rx).sum(axis=0)*(rg*rg).sum(axis=0))
# Pairwise-complete ranking for incomplete columns.
for j in np.flatnonzero(~complete):
 m=~np.isnan(g[:,j])
 if m.sum() >= 2:
  rx=st.rankdata(x[m,j],method='average'); rg=st.rankdata(g[m,j],method='average')
  rx-=rx.mean(); rg-=rg.mean()
  den=np.sqrt((rx*rx).sum()*(rg*rg).sum())
  if den: res[j]=(rx*rg).sum()/den
order_hi=np.argsort(np.nan_to_num(res,nan=-np.inf))[::-1]
order_lo=np.argsort(np.nan_to_num(res,nan=np.inf))
print('TOP raw GE positive == essentiality negative')
for j in order_hi[:15]: print(labels[j],repr(res[j]),'n',int((~np.isnan(g[:,j])).sum()))
print('TOP raw GE negative == essentiality positive')
for j in order_lo[:10]: print(labels[j],repr(res[j]),'n',int((~np.isnan(g[:,j])).sum()))
# Evaluate non-exact symbol labels sharing a unique Entrez ID.
def parsed(columns):
 d={}
 for c in columns:
  m=re.fullmatch(r'(.+) \\((\\d+)\\)',c)
  d.setdefault(m.group(2),[]).append(c)
 return d
dg=parsed(ge.columns); dx=parsed(ex.columns)
extra=[]
for eid in set(dg)&set(dx):
 if len(dg[eid])==len(dx[eid])==1 and dg[eid][0]"'!=dx[eid][0]:
  cg,cx=dg[eid][0],dx[eid][0]
  a=ge.loc[rows,cg].to_numpy(); b=ex.loc[rows,cx].to_numpy(); m=~np.isnan(a)
  if m.sum()>=2:
   rho=st.spearmanr(a[m],b[m]).statistic
   extra.append((rho,cg,cx,int(m.sum())))
print('"'TOP stable-ID renamed pairs raw GE positive')
for z in sorted(extra,reverse=True)[:15]: print(z)
print('elapsed',round(time.time()-t,2))
PY"
